normative_extracts.quote: The font-display descriptor determines how a font face is displayed based on whether and when it is downloaded and ready to use.

normative_extracts.spec_section: CSS Fonts Module Level 5: Metric Overrides
normative_extracts.quote: size-adjust, ascent-override, descent-override, and line-gap-override align fallback system font metrics with the webfont.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Controls text visibility during font download via font-display block/swap/optional timers and eliminates layout shift on swap using CSS metric overrides.

production_failures.symptom: High CLS (> 0.15) when hero heading swaps from Arial to custom webfont
production_failures.root_cause: Fallback system font had different x-height and advance width, causing lines to reflow from 2 lines to 3 lines when the webfont loaded.
production_failures.mitigation: Define a @font-face fallback with size-adjust, ascent-override, and descent-override matching the webfont's metrics.

production_failures.root_cause: Default font-display: auto behaves like block (hiding glyphs for up to 3s) while waiting on an un-preloaded WOFF2 file.
production_failures.mitigation: Use font-display: swap (with metric overrides) or font-display: optional, and preload only the primary Latin WOFF2 subset.
